Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A recorded conversation session between the user and Tania.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user who owns this conversation.

topic.description: A short summary or topic of the conversation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the conversation was created.

transcript.description: The list of messages in the conversation.

Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: A persistent monitoring tracker condition added by the user or Tania.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user who owns this reminder.

condition.description: The criteria or condition being monitored.

type.description: The category of the tracking reminder.

status.description: Whether the condition tracking is active or met.
